text:
Maya: quick design check on the routing policies editor — focusing on 3 things: priority ordering affordances, validation copy, and the preview simulation state. can people skim and flag anything that would block a tiny release? :eyes:
Alex: saw it — first pass notes: drag handle is too small, no visible drop target when reordering, and keyboard reordering lacks an accessible announcement. suggest a stronger ghost placeholder and an aria-live region for order changes.
Priya: +1. also the validation messages read a bit robotic. instead of "limit exceeded" can we use friendlier microcopy e.g. "You can pin up to 3 rules — unpin one to add another". tie it to the dedicated capacity hint when relevant.
Jo: quick constraints from infra: reordering mutates the snapshot id — that currently invalidates ongoing simulations. we should debounce snapshot updates or keep simulation pinned to the snapshot it started with. otherwise users see flicker and failed sim rows.
Ethan: for preview sim ergonomics, we should surface sampling and deterministic flags. if sim is using sampling, show a small seed badge and a tooltip like:
```
simulate(traffic: 'sampled', seed: 42, sample_rate: 0.1)
```
that helps SRE/product reproduce. also a toggle for "use live traffic" vs "sampled" would prevent confusion.
design-bot: accessibility checklist:
- focus order verified for drag handle + pin controls
- drop target has contrast >= 3:1 against bg
- aria-live announces ordering changes and validation errors
- keyboard reordering reachable via Shift+Arrow keys
(automated scan: color contrast low on the pale blue placeholder)
Alex: some microcopy ideas for validation and preview empty state: "No rules match current traffic — try relaxing filters or add a fallback rule" vs "No simulated results". also change the pin CTA from `Pin` to `Pin rule` for clarity on narrow buttons.
Priya: for priority numbering, can we show both ordinal and visual weight? e.g., "1 (high)" and a subtle bar length representing weight — helps non-technical PMs.
Jo: implementation note: adding weight bars complicates drag hitboxes. if we add bars, keep drag handle to the far left and ensure 44px touch targets.
Ethan: small bug: preview sim's timeline jumps when a rule is toggled off — that was because we re-run backend sampling synchronously. suggest a small client-side optimistic update and background refresh with a spinner.
Maya: these are great — proposed action items: Alex to push microcopy + a11y tweaks, Jo to implement snapshot-pin for simulation, Ethan to add sampling seed badge and optimistic sim UI, Priya to finalize copy. target tiny release on Thursday. @Jo @Alex @Ethan please react when you pick up. :thumbsup:
Alex: picking up microcopy + placeholder contrast fix. will post a Figma diff later today. :white_check_mark:
Jo: taking snapshot-pin work, will add debounce for reorder and verify simulation stability.
Ethan: I'll do the sim seed badge + optimistic updates. will add unit tests for timeline jitter.
Priya: will polish copy and prepare the release notes blurb — keep it short and human.
Maya: lovely. dropping a screenshot in the PR once Alex posts the figma. thanks all! :sparkles:
